\"users\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    username = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    full_name = Column(String)\n    email = Column(String, unique=True)\n    created_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Aircraft(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"aircraft\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    tail_number = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    model = Column(String)\n    empty_weight = Column(REAL)\n    max_takeoff_weight = Column(REAL)\n    created_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Flight(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"flights\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    flight_number = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    aircraft_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"aircraft.id\"), nullable=False)\n    origin = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    destination = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    departure_time = Column(DATETIME)\n    arrival_time = Column(DATETIME)\n    status = Column(String, default=\"scheduled\")\n    created_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass WeightBalance(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"weight_balance\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    flight_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"flights.id\"), unique=True, nullable=False)\n    passenger_count = Column(Integer, nullable=False)\n    baggage_weight = Column(REAL, nullable=False)\n    total_weight = Column(REAL)\n    created_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass FuelLog(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"fuel_logs\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    flight_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"flights.id\"), nullable=False)\n    fuel_uplift = Column(REAL, nullable=False)\n    logged_by = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\"), nullable=False)\n    created_at = Column(DATETIME, default=datetime.utcnow)"

      "path": "routers/group_001.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import Flight, WeightBalance, Aircraft\nfrom schemas import (\n    UpdateFlightDestinationAndRecalculateWeightResponse,\n    FlightUpdateRequest\n)\n\nrouter = APIRouter(\n    prefix=\"/api/flights\",\n    tags=[\"Flights\"]\n)\n\n\n@router.patch(\"/{flight_id}\", operation_id=\"update_flight_destination_and_recalculate_weight\", response_model=UpdateFlightDestinationAndRecalculateWeightResponse)\nasync def update_flight_destination_and_recalculate_weight(\n    flight_id: int,\n    payload: FlightUpdateRequest,\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db)\n):\n    # Fetch the flight\n    flight = db.query(Flight).filter(Flight.id == flight_id).first()\n    if not flight:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Flight not found\")\n\n    # Fetch the weight balance for this flight\n    weight_balance = db.query(WeightBalance).filter(WeightBalance.flight_id == flight_id).first()\n    if not weight_balance:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Weight balance record not found for this flight\")\n\n    # Fetch the aircraft to get empty weight\n    aircraft = db.query(Aircraft).filter(Aircraft.id == flight.aircraft_id).first()\n    if not aircraft:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Aircraft not found\")\n\n    # Update flight destination\n    flight.destination = payload.destination\n    flight.updated_at = datetime.utcnow()\n\n    # Recalculate total weight\n    new_total_weight = aircraft.empty_weight + (payload.passenger_count * 180) + payload.baggage_weight\n\n    # Update weight balance\n    weight_balance.passenger_count = payload.passenger_count\n    weight_balance.baggage_weight = payload.baggage_weight\n    weight_balance.total_weight = new_total_weight\n    weight_balance.updated_at = datetime.utcnow()\n\n    db.commit()\n    db.refresh(flight)\n    db.refresh(weight_balance)\n\n    return {\n        \"flight\": flight,\n        \"weight_balance\": weight_balance\n    }"
    },

      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import Flight, WeightBalance, Aircraft\nfrom schemas import (\n    UpdateFlightWeightBalanceResponse,\n    WeightBalanceUpdateRequest\n)\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nrouter = APIRouter(\n    prefix=\"/api/flights\",\n    tags=[\"WeightBalance\"]\n)\n\n\n@router.put(\"/{flight_id}/weight-balance\", operation_id=\"update_flight_weight_balance\", response_model=UpdateFlightWeightBalanceResponse)\nasync def update_flight_weight_balance(\n    flight_id: int,\n    payload: WeightBalanceUpdateRequest,\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db)\n):\n    # Fetch the flight\n    flight = db.query(Flight).filter(Flight.id == flight_id).first()\n    if not flight:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Flight not found\")\n\n    # Fetch the weight balance for this flight\n    weight_balance = db.query(WeightBalance).filter(WeightBalance.flight_id == flight_id).first()\n    if not weight_balance:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Weight balance record not found for this flight\")\n\n    # Fetch the aircraft to get empty weight\n    aircraft = db.query(Aircraft).filter(Aircraft.id == flight.aircraft_id).first()\n    if not aircraft:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Aircraft not found\")\n\n    # Recalculate total weight\n    new_total_weight = aircraft.empty_weight + (payload.passenger_count * 180) + payload.baggage_weight\n\n    # Update weight balance\n    weight_balance.passenger_count = payload.passenger_count\n    weight_balance.baggage_weight = payload.baggage_weight\n    weight_balance.total_weight = new_total_weight\n    weight_balance.updated_at = datetime.utcnow()\n\n    db.commit()\n    db.refresh(weight_balance)\n\n    return weight_balance"

      "path": "routers/group_003.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import Flight, FuelLog\nfrom schemas import (\n    LogFuelForFlightResponse,\n    FuelLogCreateRequest\n)\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nrouter = APIRouter(\n    prefix=\"/api/flights\",\n    tags=[\"FuelLogs\"]\n)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{flight_id}/fuel_log\", operation_id=\"log_fuel_for_flight\", response_model=LogFuelForFlightResponse)\nasync def log_fuel_for_flight(\n    flight_id: int,\n    payload: FuelLogCreateRequest,\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db)\n):\n    # Fetch the flight\n    flight = db.query(Flight).filter(Flight.id == flight_id).first()\n    if not flight:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Flight not found\")\n\n    # Create fuel log entry\n    fuel_log = FuelLog(\n        flight_id=flight_id,\n        fuel_uplift=payload.fuel_uplift,\n        logged_by=1,  # Assuming current user ID is 1 for now\n        created_at=datetime.utcnow()\n    )\n\n    db.add(fuel_log)\n    db.commit()\n    db.refresh(fuel_log)\n\n    return {\n        \"message\": \"Fuel log recorded successfully\",\n        \"fuel_log\": fuel_log\n    }"
